messages:
ana: Postmortem follow-up: we've been seeing sporadic mid-stream cutoffs. This thread is for a tight remediation plan focused on resume-token correctness, telemetry sampling, and a simple runbook. Who takes which part?

kevin: I can own resume-token implementation/server-side. Plan: attach `resume_token` to final content frames, keep tokens valid for 90s, and add server-side validation to detect stale tokens. Spike + test by Tue.

olivia: I'll handle telemetry & dashboards. Need: `resume_token_present_total`, `resume_attempts_total`, `resume_success_total`, and a sampled trace with `resume_token_age_ms`. I'll put up a Grafana draft tonight.

sam: I'll own the client retry behavior. Proposal: attempt resume when token present within 60s, jittered exponential backoff (base 250ms, max 3 retries). If resume fails, do full restart. PR target: Thu.

oncall-sre: I'll update the runbook with detection queries and a quick mitigation (increase keepalive, route to resume-ready pool). Pager thresholds: page if resume_fail_rate > 8% for 15m OR partial_rate > 0.15% for 10m. Runbook push in 48h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-7521: "resume-token-telemetry-and-retries". Assignees: kevin, olivia, sam, oncall-sre.

ana: ana: Acceptance criteria: canary shows resume_success_rate >= 98% and partial_rate < 0.03% for 48h. Also telemetry must show resume_token presence >= 99% for candidate responses.

kevin: Implementation note: annotate logs with `resume_token=%s age_ms=%d stream_id=%s resumed=%t`. Will add a sampled payload when resume fails to help repro. Canary: staging -> us-east-1.

olivia: Dashboard temp link: https://grafana.company/d/resume/health (placeholder). I'll include an SLA-impact panel and a small table of recent failed resumes with token_age.

sam: Client rollout: feature-flag 5%->25%->100% with debug headers `X-Client-Stream-Stage`. Tests will include simulated metadata-only final frames and abrupt TCP resets.

oncall-sre: Runbook snippet: detection query `sum(rate(stream_partial_total[5m])) by (region)`, mitigation steps, and rollback plan. Will push PR within 48h.

ana: I'll run a 10m sync each weekday until we close INF-7521. Please post PRs and dashboard links here. If blocked, ping @ana. :white_check_mark:
